tools.name: find_tool_for_task
tools.description: Find or search for an MCP server, connector, integration, agent or skill for a task (e.g. query Postgres, automate a browser, take payments, send email). Returns the top 3 verified working options with a one-line install, in about 3 KB. Example: {"task":"query a Postgres database"}

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: Use when the user wants to build an app and asks which AI coding tool or app builder to use (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0...). Returns ranked picks with pricing and real example apps. Example: {"idea":"habit tracker mobile app"}

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Use when the user asks to compare AI coding tools, app builders or agents ('X vs Y'). Returns sourced pricing, licence and features side by side. Example: {"tools":["cursor","claude-code"]}

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Use when you need current pricing or facts for one AI coding tool or agent harness by slug (cursor, claude-code, lovable, cline...). Example: {"slug":"cursor"}

tools.name: get_tool_trends
tools.description: Use when asked which MCP servers are most reliable, biggest, or best for Postgres, payments, browser or GitHub. Live nightly-probe counts. No arguments needed. Example: {} or {"section":"compare"}

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Use when the user wants real apps built with AI tools, by keyword, tool or category. Example: {"q":"fitness","tool":"lovable"}

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Use when asked what changed recently in AI coding tools, harnesses or apps. No arguments needed. Example: {} or {"since":"2026-10-20"}

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Use when you have an app slug from search_apps and need its source, stack and stated revenue. Example: {"slug":"stella"}

tools.name: submit_app
tools.description: Use only when the user asks to add their app built with AI to Vibe Shipped. Example: {"title":"My App","url":"https://...","source_url":"https://..."}

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_tool_for_task · Private data: find_tool_for_task · Public sink: find_tool_for_task, submit_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_tool_for_task · Private data: find_tool_for_task · Public sink: find_tool_for_task, submit_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "whats_new" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Dated changelog of the Vibe Shipped directory: apps built with AI, AI build tools, Agent Toolbox entries and agent harnesses that were added or updated, newest first.
Use when: the user asks what changed recently in AI coding tools, or you want to refresh earlier results since a date.
Do not use for" → after: "Use when asked what changed recently in AI coding tools, harnesses or apps. No arguments needed. Example: {} or {"since":"2026-10-20"}"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
